label: bad
seen: No measurement of this game exists; none was taken, and I saw no score of it or of its parent.
change: the pieces' moves: no move may capture (every move is made non-capturing, and the pawn's diagonal capture is removed); stated once, written on each of the six pieces.

proof.text: Every move of every piece has `mode` move, and the pawn has no capture move, so no piece attacks any square (en passant needs a capture move and none is generated). Check is an attack on the king, so there is never check, and checkmate (`rules.win`) needs check. Stalemate is a draw (`rules.stalemate`). No other rule decides a game. So every game is drawn, by stalemate, insufficient material or a clock.

review.notes: Hand-set positions with attackers next to the king never gave check; 200 random games all drawn; no_capture holds.
